records.issue_text: [BUG] Neither `age` nor `timestamp` is required on `BrowserReportSerializer`, so a report containing neither passes validation, but the Reporting API spec requires exactly one of the two; the mutual-exclusion validators only fire when both are present, leaving the 'neither present' case unhandled, so reports with no time information are silently accepted and logged as `browser_report_received`
records.rationale: In `BrowserReportSerializer`, both `age` and `timestamp` are declared `required=False` (so neither is mandatory). The mutual-exclusion checks are implemented in `validate_timestamp` and `validate_age`, which only run when their respective field is present in the input. Therefore, a report with *neither* `age` nor `timestamp` will pass `serializer.is_valid()` with no error. This matches the finding: the 'neither present' case is unhandled. Also, the endpoint logs `logger.info("browser_report_received", ...)` before validation, so such reports would still be logged as received.
